title: A filter that is certain about what it holds
request:
a 1024-bit filter with three positions per item, two items added, two asked about

./your_program.sh bloom
init 1024 3
add alpha
add beta
contains alpha
contains gamma
stats
note: `contains` has two answers and neither of them is `yes`. `maybe` means every one of the k bits is set, which an item that was never added can also manage once the filter is full enough. `no` is the only certain answer a Bloom filter gives.

title: What the filter will admit to
request:
three items in a filter far too small for them, then its own accounting

./your_program.sh bloom
init 64 4
add one
add two
add three
stats
note: set_bits is the honest measure of how full a filter is: it rises by at most k per add and by less once positions start colliding. When it approaches bits, every `contains` answers `maybe` and the filter has stopped saying anything.
